name: mikser-io-git
description: Two-way git sync for mikser-io. The working folder itself is the checkout, on a dedicated `mikser` branch (durable write log for API/MCP/agent edits) — `paths` names which collection folders (documents, layouts, files, ...) get auto-committed, sharing one checkout and one branch instead of a separate one per folder. Every green cycle commits + pushes whatever changed inside `paths` and attempts to merge into the target branch (`main`) via a pull request; a red cycle (any render/postprocess failure) holds the merge and leaves the PR open for a human to resolve. Inbound changes on the target branch merge back into the working copy via poll. Forge-portable: GitHub and Gitea adapters, plus a no-forge fast-forward-only floor for any bare remote.
